content:
I'm working on a term that behaves like match ... with but provides on every matchAlt the hypothesis that the left-hand side of => does not match the previous matchAlts. I'll be using splitters to implement this and I'm looking for the code that determines how the infoview behaves when the match ... with is midway through elaboration as we're writing each branch, providing a separate expected type on each branch and a hypothesis in the case we've added a pattern equality hypothesis match h : ... with. Would anyone know where in Lean.Meta.Match I could find this? (or is it somewhere else?)

(This will be used to automate nomatch proofs in WType terms)

Thanks!

EDITS:

  • It seems that InfoTrees are responsible for the information in the infoview. Does the elaborator for match specify something that involves InfoTree?
  • Lean.Elab.Term.ToDepElimPattern.savePatternInfo seems to be relevant, and some other parts of Lean.Elab.Match
